We’re tackling the critical challenges of range anxiety, downtime, and operational inefficiency in the rapidly evolving electric vehicle landscape. My background in robotics engineering, specifically within large-scale logistics operations, informs our pragmatic, problem-first approach. We’ve recently achieved significant milestones in our predictive maintenance algorithms, demonstrating a potential 15% reduction in unscheduled downtime for EV fleets.

We’re currently focused on securing seed funding to scale our development efforts and deploy pilot programs with key strategic partners. Connecting with me now offers the opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a rapidly growing company poised to become a leader in the future of mobility. I’m particularly keen to discuss potential collaborations that leverage our technology to address specific fleet management challenges.
